subject: literacy
concept: Writing a simple narrative (story) with a beginning, middle, and end
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges beginning/middle/end picture cards into a story order, then narrates it aloud
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which part (beginning, middle, end) a given sentence belongs to
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short story with a clear beginning, middle, and end

assessment.mastery_threshold: story contains identifiable beginning, middle, and end sections
misconception_flags: writes only a beginning with no real middle or end
jumps straight to an end with no setup

interest_binding: story prompt generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
